uncited: It distinguishes itself from standard 3D voxel grids by leveraging 2D convolutions for efficient feature aggregation and from pure MLPs by avoiding local minima issues associated with high-resolution spatial queries [13901-eg3d-triplane-representation.md].

It serves as a generative backbone for state-of-the-art 3D-aware GANs and efficient neural rendering of dynamic or outdoor scenes [13901-eg3d-triplane-representation.md][18169-image-conditional-triplanar-representation.md].

The family shares the mechanism of discretizing 3D space into learnable structures and querying them via differentiable interpolation, as defined in [Hierarchical and Sparse Grid Representations](23610-hierarchical-and-sparse-grid-representations.md).
Each plane stores learnable feature vectors.

The channel dimension $C$ varies by method (e.g., $C=32$ in [EG3D Triplane Representation](13901-eg3d-triplane-representation.md), or $C$ transformed to $G=C/4$ in [Image-Conditional Triplanar Representation](18169-image-conditional-triplanar-representation.md)).

For a query point $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{R}^3$, features are gathered by projecting $\mathbf{x}$ onto each canonical plane and bilinearly interpolating the nearby features [13901-eg3d-triplane-representation.md].
Let $\mathbf{f}_{xy}, \mathbf{f}_{xz}, \mathbf{f}_{yz}$ be the features gathered from the respective planes.
The output values, including color $c$, are independent of viewing direction and depend only on $\mathbf{x}$ in the static case [13901-eg3d-triplane-representation.md].

Triplane representations originated in the context of 3D-aware generative models, specifically [EG3D Triplane Representation](13901-eg3d-triplane-representation.md), which utilized them for high-fidelity image synthesis [13901-eg3d-triplane-representation.md].
